description: An over-sampled wave folder built from Chebyshev polynomials, with a truncating bit crusher in front of it and a wet mix

params.text: Sets how hard the signal is folded, 0 to 100 per cent of the shaping depth
Blends the shape between a third order Chebyshev fold at fully counter-clockwise and a fifth order one fully clockwise
Sets the step the signal is truncated to before folding, a 23 bit step at fully counter-clockwise coarsening to a 16V step fully clockwise
Mixes between the truncated input at fully counter-clockwise and the folded signal fully clockwise

inputs.text: Adds to the fold depth at a tenth of a unit per volt, on top of the FOLD knob

outputs.text: The folded signal mixed with the truncated input by the WET knob

notes: the dry half of the wet mix is the input after the truncation, not the input itself, so the bit crushing is heard at every setting of the wet knob

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
